svg.title: TestTU keeps the short test configuration
svg.desc: Tests may still assign TU.ClangTidyProvider. build() wraps it in a local module; inputs() only forwards explicit modules. ClangTidyProvider and FeatureModules are mutually exclusive in TestTU::build(). Mixed-module tests and direct inputs() callers use an explicit module set. This is a deliberate test-helper boundary.
